summary: Requested the transfer question's last timing variant: every existing receipt issues the transfer after the demotion has converged, so nothing tested a transfer that races the configuration change. In each of 20 freshly built four-voter clusters the harness starts DemoteVoter for a follower and immediately issues LeadershipTransferToServer for the same member, without waiting for the demotion to commit or for any voter to apply it, then watches for two seconds for the target to report Leader. A local probe of all 20 attempts produced no elevation: every demotion succeeded, every transfer future completed without error, the target never led, and the target's own configuration ended as non-voter in all twenty, which would make the failure silent rather than reported. Three comparisons encode that expectation, namely that no attempt sees the target lead, none ends with it leading, and all twenty transfer futures complete without error. Each attempt uses a fresh cluster because a member can be demoted only once, and the harness reports per-attempt outcomes as aggregate counts with the attempt count and membership pinned in the prerequisite. The submission validates with zero schema errors, the harness file exists, and it requests one execution.
